biological_replicate.evidence: inferred: A disintegrin and metalloproteinase with thrombospondin type I motif (ADAMTS)2, 3, and 14 are collectively named procollagen N-proteinases (pNPs) because of their specific ability to cleave the aminopropeptide of fibrillar procollagens.
inferred: we analyzed the secretomes of human fibroblasts and identified 8, 17, and 22 candidate substrates for ADAMTS2, 3, and 14, respectively.
inferred: N-terminomics (iTRAQ-TAILS) applied to the secretome of human fibroblasts co-cultured with HEK cells over-expressing the ADAMTS2, 3 or 14
